stories.title: Ondo's Tokenized Stock Platform Volume Tops $27 Billion
stories.summary: Trading volume on Ondo's tokenized-equity platform has reached $27 billion, with holdings on the platform remaining above $1 billion, according to Yahoo Finance. The figures point to continued growth in tokenized versions of traditional stocks trading on blockchain rails. Ondo has positioned itself as a bridge between conventional equities and crypto markets.
stories.whyItMatters: Tokenized equities are a real-world test of whether blockchain-based trading can pull meaningful volume away from traditional exchanges, which matters for how equity market infrastructure evolves.
whatToWatch: Whether the $27B volume figure keeps climbing or plateaus
Whether competing platforms launch similar tokenized-equity products
questions: How much of this volume reflects genuine investor demand versus speculative trading?
Are regulators examining tokenized equity platforms like this one?

stories.title: Bitcoin Is Down 44% While Its Miners Are Up 90% — the AI Pivot Explains the Gap
stories.summary: Bitcoin has fallen 44% even as bitcoin-mining stocks have surged 90%, a divergence Yahoo Finance attributes to miners pivoting toward AI computing. Miners are increasingly monetizing data-center infrastructure and power contracts for AI workloads rather than relying solely on mining economics.
stories.whyItMatters: The split shows how crypto-adjacent companies can decouple from the underlying asset's price when they diversify into AI infrastructure, a shift investors are actively re-rating.
whatToWatch: Further disclosures from miners on AI-hosting revenue versus mining revenue
Bitcoin's price trend and whether the gap narrows
questions: How durable is AI-hosting revenue for these miners long-term?
